Emily / Jacob - really appreciate the fast turnaround and the questionnaire. CC'ing Stephanie (Security) and Vivek (Solutions) to coordinate answers and scope. High level responses to help procurement triage: 

- BAA: Redwood is able to execute a BAA for customers that put workloads on Dedicated reserved capacity or Private deployments (VPC or on-prem). We can provide a signed BAA prior to production access.
- PHI handling boundaries: we treat PHI as data the customer elects to send; Redwood's standard hosted public API offering (shared multi-tenant) is not recommended for PHI. Dedicated pools (isolated GPU capacity) and Private deployments support PHI and additional contractual controls (KMS/HSM integration, audit logging, restricted egress).
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; Stephanie will share the relevant SOC 2 report excerpts and our control mappings for the questionnaire.
- Data residency/retention: Supported in Private and Dedicated via region pinning and configurable retention. Will confirm specifics for MediHealth's region.

Proposed next steps:
1) Stephanie and Vivek will fill the questionnaire sections related to security architecture, encryption, SOC 2, and deployment-to-deployment differences.
2) I'll schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive this week with your security/procurement to walk through any redlines and the BAA.
3) We will return a completed questionnaire + SOC 2 excerpts and a draft BAA within 5 business days if that's acceptable.

Does that timeline work? If so, Jacob - can you confirm the preferred mailbox for receiving the draft BAA and any procurement-specific signatory details?

Thanks,
Marissa
